name: Pressing Update branch is not people rewriting CoderHelm's change
about: Coder lessons said changes in one area were 'rewritten by people before merging, 100% of the diff changed' on PR after PR. The share compared CoderHelm's last commit with the merged head, so the base branch a person merged in with Update branch counted as their edits, and that merge commit counted as a person's commit. Only people's own non-merge commits count now, each by its own size.
